Search library's collection. File reservation requests. Online book borrowing, renewal, and many more. Contact Us UM DLP MAIN Welcome Back! Use your University of Mindanao Google account

                  Use , Privacy
                  Policy , and Data Policy LEARNING AND INFORMATION CENTER LEARNING AND INFORMATION CENTER As a hub of intellectual inquiry, UM-LIC provides resources and venue for creative dialogue, research, interdisciplinary pursuits and cultural activities that support scholarly endeavors of leaders in society. No facilities and services cards are published yet. ONLINE RESEARCH AND REFERENCE

              Us. Login your account now. Access the library's online resources and services anytime, anywhere. Technical Services Services - 4 Library operations concerned with the acquisition, organization and maintenance of the library collection. 1. ACQUISITION Handles the development of print and non-print collection of the LIC by selection,
              ordering and purchasing of library materials in cooperation with the faculty and staff of the
              university. Online Book Requisition The faculty can use the online book order form to recommend/purchase of books and other
                resources relevant to their program. Click to fill out the Online Book Order Form 2. CATALOGING Centralized system that takes care of the organization of library materials through
              bibliographic description, classification and mechanical processing of library materials to facilitate
              access to all materials that the library holds and acquires. Responsible in the maintenance of the OPAC, Destiny database, shelf-list, and union
              catalog
              of the LIC. 3. PRESERVATION AND CONSERVATION Handles the maintenance of library materials through mending and repair. Preservation includes all activities associated with the maintenance
                of
                resources and preservation of information content. Conservation refers to the treatment of the physical items themselves
                in
                order to extend their usable life through binding and repair. Book Quarantine All returned materials and received packages
                  shall be quarantined in a designated area for a period of 5 days. 4. ABSTRACTING AND INDEXING SERVICE Organizes information to make it more readily available and easily retrievable to users
            through abstracts and indexes. Abstracts and Indexes are accessed in the Online Public Access Catalog . Readers’ Services Services -
                  12 Oversees the operations of all the programs, services, and facilities that concern the information needs
            of UM faculty and students. 1. CIRCULATION SERVICES Responsible for the checking out (borrowing), checking in (returning), renewal, recall
              and
              overdue fines computation of library materials through the circulation desk. Book Borrowing Drive-Thru Students and Faculty can borrow books by contacting the library through the following: Email: library@umindanao.edu.ph Contact Number: 0951-376-6681 Borrowers can pick-up the book/s at the library drive-thru area near Gate 3 (Bolton
                campus); Gravahan Gate and Maa Gate (Matina Campus). Online Document Delivery Service for Book Returns Students and faculty may return all borrowed books through the LIBRARY BOOK DROPS
                placed
                at
                the entrance gate of the University of Mindanao-Main Campus (Gate 3 – UM Bolton; Gravahan and Maa
                Gates–Matina Campus). Online Document Delivery It is an electronic delivery of document service provided to all bona fide students and
                faculty upon request. They can request a scanned copy of book pages (not more than 10% of the book) free
                of charge. 2. Virtual
                Reference Service This service provides assistance, guidance, and instruction to users in accessing and
              retrieving information as well as help users prepare bibliography of all forms of information resources
              via online platform. Online Research and Reference Assistance
              (ORRA) ORRA is our virtual reference assistance service wherein librarians can answer questions
              about research and assignment of students, library account, downloading e-books, and other library-related
              queries via chat and email. 3. Periodical
                Services Provide local and foreign journals, magazines, newspapers; and, clippings from newspapers
              and ephemeral materials. Periodical materials with completed issues are bound and indexed for easy access. 4. Provision of Filipiniana materials LIC provides books on various subjects or topics in Philippine setting, or any topic
              related
              to the Philippines regardless of author and imprint. 5. Provision of UMiana Materials Provide information about the University of Mindanao, its founder, achievements and
              publications. 6. Cultural Heritage Resource Center and Mindanaoan Materials Features various materials about the cultural heritage of Mindanao. 7. Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Knowledge Resource Network (BSP-KRN) A program promoting the understanding of essential economic and financial concepts and
              issues through the exchange of information resources between the BSP library and UM Learning and
              Information Center. This collaboration offers publications from the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas for the
              utilization of students of the University of Mindanao. 8. Provision of UN/ADB/WB collections Provides publications of United Nations, Asian Development Bank and World Bank. 9. Donation Corner Provides area for the display of books donated by the Friends of the Library. 10. Online Information Literacy Program Video presentations of the following topics are uploaded in the Google Classroom for
              sharing
              to the students and faculty. Virtual orientation is conducted via the Zoom Application. General Library Instruction Instructional program that aims to teach patrons on how to locate the information they
              need
              quickly and effectively thru the following: How to access the Online Public Access Catalog (OPAC) – Creating Destiny accounts to view
                and maximize the features of the OPAC. Online instruction on the new normal library services. Bibliography Making Teach students how to write a bibliography for a research paper. Online Database Instruction Teach students how to access and create account on the subscribed online databases
              namely:
              Proquest E-book Central, Wiley Online Library, ACM Digital Library, Proquest Central, Philippine
              E-journals, Gale Reference Complete and Odilo Digital Library. 11. Resource Sharing Service Provide referral letters for students planning to use the library facilities of other
              institutions. Likewise, the LIC caters users from other institutions with referral letters from their
              respective heads of libraries. 12. Current Awareness Service (CAS) Provides updates to new acquisitions and events of the LIC through the library website,
              FB
              page and bulletin board display. ICT Services Services - 11 1. Internet and E-resources Services Provides computers to access the internet and the online databases subscribed by the LIC. 2. Subscribed Online Databases Provides e-books and e-journals e-books E-books Central, ACM Digital Library, Wiley Online Library, Oxford Reference, Odilo
                Digital Library e-journals Proquest central, Phil. E-journals, Gale Reference Complete e-platform contains the most updated fiction e-books and audiobooks. 3. Open Access Resources An enumerative list of websites, which information contents are made freely available via
              the internet. The URLs of the web sites are embedded in the resource list, enabling the users to connect
              to the site by clicking on it. 4. CD-ROM and Multimedia Services Houses the electronic resources (CD-ROMs) some of which are accompanying materials of
              books.
              Computer units are installed at the area to access these resources. 5. Free Wi-Fi There are Wi-Fi spots distributed inside the LIC premises both Bolton and Matina
              campuses. 6. Web OPAC The electronic version of the card catalog. It is an organized and searchable collection
              of
              records of library resources; this will help library users locate a particular item in the library. This
              can be accessed anytime and anywhere as long as there is internet connection. 7. Online Entrance Monitoring Service An electronic device that captures data of users entering the library premises for the
              purpose of efficiently, accurately & expeditiously record library attendance. Users are requested to scan
              their IDs upon entering the LIC. 8. Tablet Lending Service Tablets are to be borrowed by users within the LIC premises only. These tablets shall be
              used for research, acquisition of information, reading e-books, email and e-learning activities to address
              educational needs and different learning styles of users. 9. Library Website Provides current information about the UM Learning and Information Center. This is also
              used
              to promote the library resources and services. 10. Facebook Page Facebook Page is
              created to promote library services, resources and library-related activities. 11. Digitization Project Establishment of Institutional Repository through the Digitization project is an ongoing
              project. All manuscript collections are digitized and uploaded in the Dspace database. LIC Branches LIC Bansalan LIC Digos LIC Panabo LIC Peñaplata LIC Tagum UM DLP MAIN © UM DLP MAIN | ICTC. All Rights Reserved. Privacy Terms Feedback Support
